---
"@slidestage/brand": minor
---

Add the SlideStage product registry (`@slidestage/brand/products`) and the
`slidestage-render-ecosystem` CLI (also reachable as
`@slidestage/brand/tools/render-ecosystem.mjs`). Consumers can keep their
README "SlideStage ecosystem" section in sync with the canonical product
list by anchoring a marker block:

```
<!-- BEGIN: slidestage-ecosystem · auto-generated by @slidestage/brand · DO NOT EDIT -->
<!-- END: slidestage-ecosystem -->
```

and wiring `pnpm render:ecosystem` / `pnpm check:ecosystem-readme` scripts
that call the bundled CLI. The registry data lives in
`src/products.data.mjs` (pure ESM) with a typed re-export in
`src/products.ts` so it stays accessible to both Node tooling and TS
consumers without a build step.

No breaking changes — all existing asset / token exports remain unchanged.
